payload.artist_html: Johann Theodor de Bry
payload.credit_html: Het Tweede Boeck, scan from http://julianhume.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2010/07/History-of-the-dodo-Hume.pdf
payload.description_html: Copper engraving (made in the Netherlands) showing Dutch activities on the shore of Mauritius, as well as the first published depiction of a dodo bird (Raphus cucullatus), on the left. The now extinct tortoise Cylindraspis and an unidentified Pteropus (bat) are shown as well.
